restaurant_name: Rung Aroon Hotel by Le Siri
text:
My stay at the Rung Aroon Hotel by Le Siri was truly delightful. The hotel is located in a quiet area, slightly outside the Old City, yet still very accessible — just a short car ride away from Chiang Mai’s main attractions.

The staff were incredibly warm and welcoming throughout my stay. They offered great recommendations for nearby restaurants and local activities. One gesture that genuinely exceeded my expectations was when the owner himself drove us in his personal car to the meeting point of one of our booked tours. This level of care is rare and deeply appreciated.

The breakfast was another highlight: delicious, generous, and clearly prepared with attention to detail. I also noticed how meticulous they are with cleanliness — something I value greatly, and the hotel absolutely excels at.

Without a doubt, I would stay here again on my next visit to Chiang Mai. Highly recommended.

restaurant_name: Rung Aroon Hotel by Le Siri
text:
Super clean - felt like it’s new but turns out that it has already been there for many years. Convenient location to supermarkets, food street, and famous spots like Coconut Market / JJ market, etc. A little away from the city center so it’s more serene and peaceful!

Breakfast is good with different Thai dishes everyday, owner is super friendly and thoughtful as well; he even packed sandwiches 🥪 for us to bring along our super early and long road trip for one of the days, and gave us Mandarin oranges as we visited during Lunar New Year 🍊🍊😍😍

Some black ants running around the basins (but they don’t bite) just need to flag to housekeeping and it’ll be settled!
